zones.label: Schengen area
zones.authority: European Commission, Migration and Home Affairs
zones.evidenceExcerpt: The Schengen area is composed of 29 countries: 25 EU Member States and 4 non-EU countries (Iceland, Norway, Switzerland and Liechtenstein). Bulgaria and Romania were the last countries to join on 1 January 2025; Cyprus is still integrating and Ireland applies an opt-out.
